The Barn

A 206-year-old barn, lowered 12 inches to meet code, lined with its own original boards, and lit by the 200-year-old windows from the house. Tables and chairs are included with rental.

The main floor

Ceremony seating for your guests, or dining at 6-foot and 8-foot tables or 5-foot rounds. We have tried the layouts: rows for a ceremony, long tables down the length of the barn, or rounds with room to move. The main floor opens through French doors onto the patio.

The loft

A second level with its own dining space, looking down into the barn. Upstairs dining seats 20 on one side and 18 on the other.

The bridal room

In the ell, off the hallway with its original celestial window. Sheer curtains, a vanity, an arched mirror, a chandelier, and a hook made for your wedding dress.

The groom’s room

A second room in the ell for the groom and groomsmen, with a mirror and a bench made from the barn’s old beams.

The prep kitchen

A kitchen for your caterer, with barn doors on the open sides that close for privacy while they finish the meal. Outside caterers are welcome. [CONFIRM: any caterer requirements]

The patio and the grounds

A paved patio off the barn with room for nine tables and 72 seats, string lights for the evening, and a paved path around the barn. Two 12-foot stone planters and a seating circle were built from rocks that sat under the barn since 1820. Beyond them, the ceremony field looks at Pleasant Mountain.

The ceremony field

Benches made from the barn’s original floorboards, set in the field. An arbor made from the barn’s posts and beams is planned. [CONFIRM: arbor built]
